Name: A Little More Cutscenes
Author: zilchaz
Description:
This mod adds a variety of new events, short stories, and character interactions in various situations.
Playing with new save is recommended as some events have a specific condition.

[font=Arial][color=#f4cccc][size=5]Events Condition[/size][/color][/font]
Currently, there are 22 events in total.

[font=Arial][color=#f4cccc][size=5]Compatible[/size][/color][/font]
[b]Supported[/b] Nyapu's Portraits for custom portraits in events.
[b]Not [u]fully[/u] compatible[/b] with SVE. Some events are disabled if SVE is installed. (Mostly because of major changes in maps)
[b]DSV compatible[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url] has added compatibility for custom portraits.
